messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: High throttle & queue depth on inference-api (model=rwd-gpt-medium, region=us-east1). tokens/sec=185k, queue_depth=920, throttle_rate=18%. Paging eng-sre on-call (maria) and infra (aj).

maria (oncall): Acked. I'm looking. Assigning to infra for emergency scale. @aj please take. :oncoming_police_car:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-0452 acknowledged by maria (oncall). Notifying escalation policy.

aj (infra): On it. Running emergency scale and bumping HPA min/max. Running commands now:
```
# scale dedicated pool and bump HPA
./infra scale --pool inference-dedicated-us-east1 --replicas 14 --burst true
kubectl patch hpa inference-runtime -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6,"maxReplicas":18}}'
```

leo (runtime): I see a sudden flood of short requests causing KV cache misses; many cold-prefix hits for rwd-gpt-medium-v2-rollout. Quick mitigation: enable prefix caching + extend KV cache TTL for 5m on the variant. Pushing small runtime toggle now.

maria (oncall): Noted customer impact while you scale — checking logs: 3 customers with elevated 429/5xx rates (acct:acme, finlytics, chatly). Support pinged. Will draft a short customer note after we stabilize.

aj (infra): Scale applied. Observability: throttle_rate down to 4%, tokens/sec -> 110k, queue_depth -> 320. Good immediate effect. However alerts were noisy — queue_depth alert fired multiple times during the burst. Proposing tuning to avoid pages for short spikes:
- change queue_depth alert trigger from 700 to 1000 but require 5m sustained
- change tokens/sec alert from 120k (instant) to 220k sustained 1m
- add new alert: throttle_rate > 10% sustained for 2m (pager)

leo (runtime): +1 to those thresholds. Also we should add a dashboard panel: tokens/sec by model and top-10 customers, plus per-model queue_depth heatmap. I'll spin up a quick Grafana panel and attach link.

jess (product): Thanks — can someone summarize customer impact (counts, time window, which regions) so I can start a comms draft? Need bullets for support and CSMs.

aj (infra): Quick numbers from logs: 3 affected customers, spike window ~ 12:07–12:18 UTC, peak throttle at 12:09 UTC. Most traffic from us-east1. I'll export a CSV and drop in the incident folder.

maria (oncall): Handoff: I'll hand to aj for monitoring and mitigation for the next 3 hours. @sre_lead please own the post-incident actions (alerts, runbook). I'm leaving a short timeline in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Handoff recorded: INC-2026-0452 now assigned to aj (oncall). Next on-call acknowledged.

sre_lead: Good response. After we close, we need the following follow-ups: 1) PR for alert tuning (queue_depth/tokens/sec/throttle); 2) Grafana dashboard for tokens/sec by model/top customers; 3) Runbook update for "burst with KV cache miss" mitigation steps. Assigning to aj/leo. ETA: EOD.

aj (infra): Created PRs: #1423 (alert-thresholds) and #1424 (grafana-quickpanel). Also added a temporary suppression rule to avoid paging on 1m transient spikes while we validate thresholds. Tagging reviewers.

jess (product): Please include the short customer-impact bullet list in #1423 or in the incident doc so I can pull for comms.

maria (oncall): Closing the page for now — system stabilized and throttles returned to normal after scale + caching. Moving to monitoring timeline and tracking the PRs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

leo (runtime): I'll follow up with a small perf note: we should evaluate prefix caching heuristics; a missed optimization on small prompts amplified token/sec. Will add to the postmortem checklist.

sre_lead: Thanks team — postmortem ticket INC-2026-0452-PM created. Assigning reviewers: aj, leo, maria. Put any logs/CSVs in /incidents/INC-2026-0452/.

maria (oncall): Final: action items captured, PR links posted, customer support notified. Switching to async updates.

[reactions: maria :white_check_mark:, aj :thumbsup:, leo :eyes:]
